title: Kayo Organa
description: Married to Queen Breha Organa's sister, Celly, Duke Kayo Organa and their child, Niano, visited the royal palace often. Kayo enjoyed arguing politics with his in-laws, even advocating for all of the profits he enjoyed under the reign of the Empire, despite the atrocities they committed. The pompous man had little idea that he was talking to two important leaders of the rebellion against the Empire.
